Player.title: Player
Player.description: Represents a player in the Hell Let Loose game.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Player entity.

matchesPlayed.description: Number of matches played by the player.

Match.title: Match
Match.description: Represents a single match in Hell Let Loose. Contains the full data object from the external API.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Match entity.

start.description: The date and time when the match started.

end.description: The date and time when the match ended.

player_stats.description: Statistics for each player in the match.

PlayerAggregates.title: PlayerAggregates
PlayerAggregates.description: Aggregated statistics for a single player across all matches.

processedServers.description: A map where each key is a server name and the value is the ID of the last match processed for that player on that server.

/rawMatchResults/{matchId}.description: Collection to store raw match data from the external API. Documents in this collection trigger the aggregation Cloud Function and are deleted after successful processing.

/playerAggregates/{playerId}.description: Global collection of aggregated player statistics. Each document represents a single player and contains their consolidated stats from all processed matches.
